title: Use a signal on the timeline
summary: Put a saved signal on a Signal track and it plays live with the arrangement; its public variables can be automated.
alternateQueries: How do I put my Signal Lab sound on the timeline?
Can I automate a Signal Lab value?

steps.instruction: Press a track's kind button and choose Signal, or add a clip to a Signal track.
Right-click the track and choose Add Clip... then choose the saved signal.
steps.expectedResult: A Signal clip appears; its length comes from the signal.

blocks.text: Signal clips are played live by the timeline, one voice per clip, not from a fixed recording. Changing a public variable while it plays changes the sound.
Rendering the master mix includes Signal clips.
